scope: Full elaboration and kernel checking of the generated single file by `lean` on the author's machine, with LEAN_PATH pointing at a prebuilt cache of the pinned Mathlib. Not run through `lake env`, so lean4web/lakefile.toml and lake-manifest.json are not exercised. Hosted Lean4Web not tested.

statement_comparison.scope: The three Mathlib-only targets of this file, and every definition their statements use, have the same types and bodies as in the compiled Comparator challenge, after every auxiliary theorem `Foo._proof_n` is replaced by its proof term (lean/scripts/CompareSingleFile.lean, run with `lean --run`). The constant-by-constant comparison of CompareStatement.lean does not apply to the single file: its definitions refer to auxiliary proofs created earlier in the file under other names.
